hook: An early-branching green alga packs seven carotenoids into each light-harvesting antenna subunit.
summary: Mesostigma viride sits near the transition from algae to land plants. A cryo-EM structure of its photosystem II and light-harvesting supercomplex shows a core much like that of land plants, plus antenna proteins carrying many carotenoids, including marine-type ones that widen blue-green absorption. This is a static structure of one species, so photoprotection roles are inferred, not tested.
title: Structural insights into light harvesting and photosystem II evolution in the basal streptophyte Mesostigma viride.
